rules.rule: Progressive disclosure: show only what the user needs at this step. Maximum 1 input field per screen during onboarding. Never ask for information you don't immediately need.
First screen must communicate core value proposition in 1 headline (max 6 words) and 1 supporting sentence. Show the app's benefit, not its features.
Use full-bleed illustrations or animations on value screens. Illustrations should show the app in use, not abstract concepts. Lottie animations preferred over static images.
Step indicator: small dots or thin progress bar at top. Show how many steps remain. Never more than 5 steps in onboarding before reaching the main app.
Always offer a skip option in top-right corner (except for mandatory account creation). Skip should be obvious but not more prominent than the primary CTA.
